title: Yoneda embedding
description: JSON Schema for the Yoneda embedding 𝒴 : C → [C^op, Set], A ↦ Hom_C(-, A) — the fully faithful functor sending each object of C to its contravariant hom-functor (Yoneda 1954; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §2). The Yoneda lemma makes this functor full and faithful, identifying C with a full subcategory of its presheaf category.

source-category.description: The category C being embedded. The Yoneda embedding takes C into its presheaf category [C^op, Set].
